name: He Fucked the Girl Out of Me.
source:
He Fucked The Girl Out Of Me is a semi-autobiographical narrative visual novel about trauma and sex work made for the gameboy. The author explains how sex work impacted her life and changed her perception of the world.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2293660/]Steam[/url]]
